statement_summary: Security officer for IT and OT designated in writing
Risk acceptance levels; no High acceptance of toxic release risks
Security clauses and SOC 2 review for vendors
Annual control assessment
Cyber risks in RMP hazard reviews
MOC for control system and recipe changes; regulatory inventory limits
Unique accounts including DCS operator stations
MFA for remote and administrative access
Same-day removal of all access including OT accounts and rack cards
OT remote access only through the gateway with MFA, approval, and recording
SIS engineering access and keyswitch control
Change default passwords before connecting devices
Report suspected incidents immediately; treat as a process upset
Safe state first; no restart on an unverified DCS
Immediate release notification to NRC, SERC, and LEPC
Notification path independent of the business network
Annual OT tabletop and notification exercise
OT contingency plan from the BIA
Protect legacy CVI
Approved and scanned media only on OT workstations
Offline or immutable backups; quarterly restores; SIS compare
Annual awareness training for all; OT training for operators and contractors
No software installation; OT software only under MOC
Approved generative AI tools only; no formulations or process data in public tools
